objects.name: Hackers exploit Gyazo server flaw to steal 23.6 million user records
objects.description: Japanese software company Helpfeel has confirmed a data breach on its screenshot-sharing platform Gyazo, in which attackers exploited a vulnerability in its image upload server, stealing approximately 23.62 million user records and metadata tied to hundreds of millions of images.
